image_description: A side-profile view of a lionfish (Pterois) resting on a sandy or textured seabed. The fish displays characteristic vertical red/brown and white stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins, and prominent dorsal spines. The lighting appears artificial, likely from a camera flash, casting shadows behind the fish.
